Tree Fact

In Sevier County, Utah, United States, there is a cluster of quaking aspen trees named Pando. This "cluster" is actually connected by one massive root system, spanning 106 acres. Since the multi-root system is connected within itself, its considered to be all one tree, making Pando the largest tree by weight and landmass! By estimating the nearby Fish Lake Plateau's last glacier formation (a time where the Pando could not have formed due to the cold), researchers believe its from 9,000 to 16,000 years old! It also uses a special process called 'suckering' where the stems die seperately from the parent root system, and then are replaced by genetically identical stems. These stems then grow to appear to be individial trees.
